spec.name: sprint35_taker_imbalance_liquid_majors
spec.hypothesis: Short-horizon taker buy/sell volume imbalance predicts 10-min forward returns in the most liquid names, surviving costs where tail-liquidity baskets could not.
spec.power_argument: n_expected>=300 (5 symbols x ~6 entries/day x ~21d window); MDE~9.2bps at t=2 using sprint34 per-trade sd=79.6bps as prior
